title: Plenary and Keynote Sessions
summary: Confirmed plenary and keynote speakers will appear here.

paragraphs: IEEE SSCI 2027 plans to host distinguished keynote and plenary speakers from academia and industry addressing emerging frontiers in computational intelligence. The current proposal draft states that the conference will host 23 distinguished keynote speakers from academia or industry. Speaker names, talk titles, abstracts, and schedules will be updated after confirmation.
